name: E2E MCP Tools Plugin
description: E2E fixture: contributes one MCP tool at activation and records what the host lists for it.
author: Clubhouse E2E

topics.title: E2E MCP Tools Plugin
topics.content: Fixture plugin. activate() contributes the `e2e_echo` MCP tool, then writes the listed tool names (or the error) to `data-e2e-mcp-tools` on the document element.
